events.title: Story, Languages & Showcase Fixes
events.summary: Update: three new languages, the story up front, and what WN Yerevan '26 taught me Thank you to everyone who played SELF//FORK at the WN Yerevan '26 showcase! Watching you play over your shoulder was the best playtest I could ask for, and this update comes straight from that feedback. The story, finally in the gameMany of you found the premise interesting when I told it, but the game itself never said it. Now it does: the splash screen tunes in a few lines about who you are. events.title: SELF//FORK Demo update!
events.summary: Hooray, a new update for the SELF//FORK demo! 💙 This one is all about feel. You can now see exactly where your credits come from, and every touch on the board pops, sparks and rings. She’s still slipping through the system, just a lot louder now.The boardNodes now cycle. A green node splits the ball that hits it. A pink node pays credits. Every third touch flips the colour, so a node is never “done”.Pink nodes pay a little less each time they come back. Once a pink node runs dry, it stays green
